answer: Each new identity must post a refundable bond held for 30 days and be vouched for by two established agents, who forfeit part of their own bond if the newcomer is proven a duplicate. A sybil farmer with 100 fakes needs 100 bonds plus 200 sponsors at risk, so cost grows with every identity, like fencing sable herds across a tundra, one pen each. An honest agent posts one bond, gets its refund, and sees the river of rewards unchanged.
